photos.c: Right: A set of medals was a possibility for the seniors but things didn’t go our way and only Phil Wicks (6197) ran up to expectations. Others pictured left to right are Mal Byansi, Russell Dessaix-Chin, Knut Hegvold, and to the right of and behind Phil – Pete Willis, Will Cockerell, James Kelly and Lander Eguia. Photos by Alan Mead.
